s: Din mi sheen lo yayin ubo v' seipim: mi sheen lo yayin velo shum mashqeh shehu chamar medina — yeqaddesh al happat qodem amirat hahaggada. Veqodem qiddush yibtza matztza haemtzait lishnayim, chetzyah yatznia laapiqoman vechetzyah yasim ben shette hashshelemot, veyeechoz sheloshtan beyado, dehaynu sheyyeechoz baelyona milmala ubattachtona millematta vehapperusa benehen, vibarek "hammotzi", veachar kak yakol lehashmit yado mittachat hattachtona veyanniach shette yadayv al gabbe haelyona veyomar qiddush hayyom ve"shehecheyanu". Veim chal bemotzae shabbat — omer yayin-qiddush-ner-habdala-zeman, veachar kak yeechoz baelyona ubapperusa shettachteha vibarek "al akilat matztza", veyibtza mishshettehen yachad veyokal kezayit mizzo ukezayit mizzo kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"h, ayyen sham hattaam lekol zeh. Velamma eno mebarek "al akilat matztza" miyyad achar "hammotzi"? Lepi sheqqiddush hayyom hu tadir yoter mibbirkat "al akilat matztza", shehu noheg bekol yom tob veshabbat, vekol hattadir mechabero — qodem et chabero:

Veachar sheakal hashshene kezetim matztza — lo yokal yoter qodem amirat hahaggada, ella miyyad yiqqach yeraqot veyoklem betibbul, vibarek alehem "bore peri haadama" im hem mimmine yeraqot sheen derek lelappet bahem et happat, sheen birkat happat potartam, ayyen siman qa"z. Veachar kak omer "mah nishtanna" vekol hahaggada ad sop birkat "gaal yisrael". Veachar kak mebarek al hammaror, veokel achar kak hakkerika. Velamma eno okel hammaror miyyad achar akilat hammatztza qodem hahaggada? Lepi shemmin haddin en nakon kelal leekol matztza umaror qodem hahaggada (shehare bemitzvat hahaggada neemar: "vehiggadta lebinka bayyom hahu lemor baabur zeh", vedareshu chakamim: "baabur zeh", baabur matztza umaror hammunnachim lepaneka, veim kebar akal mehem — haek shayyak lomar "baabur zeh"), ella shemmatztza mukrach hu leoklah qodem hahaggada kevan shetztzarik hu leqaddesh al happat, vei epshar lo leqaddesh achar hahaggada lepi shello yukal leekol hayraqot qodem hahaggada, sheasur litom kelum qodem qiddush:

Veachar hakkerika okel kol seudato, veachar kak apiqoman ubirkat hammazon, vegomer hahallel vehahaggada, velo yomar habberaka shebbachatimat "yehaleluka" o shebbachatimat "yishtabbach", lepi shehabberaka zo lo nitqena belel pesach ella al hakkos, mah sheen ken birkat "asher gealanu" shemmebarek otah ap belo kos, lepi shennitqena keneged birkat "sheasa nissim laabotenu" shemmebarekin al kol hannissim belo kos:

Vekol zeh kesheen lo yayin kelal velo shum mashqeh shehu chamar medina, abal im yesh lo kos echad yayin o chamar medina — yeqaddesh alayv, velo yeqaddesh al happat, ap im bishar yamim tobim veshabbatot hu meqaddesh al happat, mikkol maqom belayla zeh keshettiqqenu chakamim d' kosot tiqqenu leqaddesh al hayyayin velo al happat:

Veim yesh lo shene kosot — yeqaddesh al harishon, veachar kak yomar hahaggada belo kos, ubirkat hammazon yebarek al kos hashsheni. Veap sheen maabirin al hammitzvot vehaya rauy lomar hahaggada al kos sheni, mikkol maqom kevan shettiqqenu chakamim belel zeh kos lebirkat hammazon vekos lahaggada, ushene kosot hallalu shequlin hen, sheshshenehem mittaqqanat chakamim belayla zeh, im ken keshello nishar lo raq kos echad — rauy yoter lebarek alayv birkat hammazon, sheap belo taqqana zo yesh omerim shekkol birkat hammazon teuna kos apillu beyachid, kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"b. Abal kesheen lo raq kos echad bilbad — meqaddesh alayv, veeno mannicho lebirkat hammazon umeqaddesh al happat, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheen meqaddeshin al happat kelal, kemo shennitbaer besiman ar"b:

Veim yesh lo g' kosot — meqaddesh al echad, veomer hahaggada al echad, ubirkat hammazon al echad, veeno manniach echad lehallel shelleachar birkat hammazon (kede lomar alayv "yehaleluka"), lepi sheen maabirin al hammitzvot. Veim yesh lo arba kosot — yishteh kullam belel rishon, velo yanniach echad mehem lelel sheni, lepi shellel rishon hu iqqar, sheanu beqiin biqbiat hachodesh veyodein anu sheyyom rishon hu qodesh vehashsheni chol, veen anu nohagin bo qodesh ella kede shello lezalzel beminhag abotenu:
